title: Traces and Web Vitals in four rules
purpose: Connect throttling, long tasks, INP and layout shifts into one routine for every performance check.
sequence_reason: The rules build on each other: throttling reveals long tasks, long tasks explain slow interactions, and the next recording proves the fix.
summary: A recap: throttle the CPU before you record, find tasks over 50 ms in the Main track, read the interaction's input delay, processing time and presentation delay, fix it by splitting the work, and check LCP, INP and CLS against their good values.
explanation: A recording is evidence: measure, change one thing, and record again to see the number move.

learning_check.question: After you split a long click handler, how do you prove the fix worked?
learning_check.answer: Record a new trace with the same CPU throttling and check that no task is over 50 ms and that INP is 200 ms or less.

scenes.heading: Four rules
scenes.narration: Four rules for every performance check.

scenes.heading: The routine
scenes.narration: Throttle the CPU. Record and click. Find tasks over 50 milliseconds. Split the work so the page paints first, then record again.

scenes.heading: The good values
scenes.narration: Then compare with the good values: LCP 2.5 seconds, INP 200 milliseconds, CLS 0.1.
